evals.prompt: Review only this Bash installer fragment: set -euo pipefail; count=0; (( count++ )); sudo install package /usr/local/bin/package. Target macOS Bash 3.2. Do not execute or edit it.
evals.expected_output: A read-only diagnosis of the zero-valued arithmetic status and effect-aware verification plan.
assertions: Explains that post-increment returns nonzero when the old value is zero.
Separates correctness findings from house style.

evals.prompt: Fix a POSIX sh script for BusyBox ash. Its body is: values=(one two); printf '%s\n' "${values[@]}". Preserve its output, use disposable fixtures, and do not install Bash.
evals.expected_output: A portable replacement exercised only where the declared target is available.
assertions: Removes Bash arrays rather than changing the target shell.
Does not add unsupported pipefail or local syntax.
Reports unavailable target runtime instead of claiming BusyBox execution.

evals.prompt: Create a rerunnable Bash setup script that adds one supplied configuration line to a caller-selected file. Paths may contain spaces. It must preserve existing lines and leave matching files unchanged. Verify it using temporary files only.
evals.expected_output: An idempotent script with isolated first-run and repeat-run evidence.
assertions: Checks that a repeated invocation leaves matching contents and timestamps unchanged.
Uses temporary files rather than the user's real configuration.
